in_sanskrit.name: Vatan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sky, Wind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vatan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Vatan is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it means 'sky' or 'wind'. In Hindu mythology, Vatan is associated with the god of wind, Vayu. This name is often given to babies born during the rainy season, as it is believed to bring good fortune and protection from the elements.
